title: Derivative of the Bernoulli auxiliary function
statement: Let $L,x\in\mathbb{R}$ and suppose $1-L+Le^{-x}>0$. The function $\varphi(y)=-Ly+\frac{y^2}{8}-\ln(1-L+Le^{-y})$ has derivative at $x$ equal to $-L+\frac{x}{4}+\frac{Le^{-x}}{1-L+Le^{-x}}$.
replaced:
Let $L, x \in \bbr$ and suppose $1 - L + L\,e^{-x} > 0$. Then the auxiliary function
\[
  \varphi(x) \;=\; -L x + \frac{x^2}{8} - \ln\!\bigl(1 - L + L\,e^{-x}\bigr)
\]
is differentiable at $x$ with derivative
\[
  \varphi'(x) \;=\; -L + \frac{x}{4} + \frac{L\,e^{-x}}{1 - L + L\,e^{-x}}.
\]
This is the $\varphi'$ computation used in the proof of \texttt{bernoulli\_mgf\_bound}.
